description: Evidence record schema for The Absolute Effect. Add one object per treatment/outcome.

fields.discipline: Medical Oncology | Radiation Oncology | Surgical Oncology
fields.setting: Adjuvant | Neoadjuvant | Definitive | Palliative | Metastatic | Imaging | Biomarker | Pathology | Theranostic Trials
fields.nnt: NNT at specified horizon and explicitly named endpoint
fields.harmLabel: Trial-specific principal toxicity/harm endpoint used for NNH
fields.nnH: NNH at specified horizon and explicitly named toxicity endpoint; use not quantifiable when appropriate

special_settings.Imaging: Trials primarily evaluating imaging strategies, imaging-based detection, surveillance or response assessment
special_settings.Biomarker: Trials primarily evaluating biomarkers, molecular signatures or predictive/prognostic markers
special_settings.Pathology: Trials primarily evaluating pathology, histologic classification or pathology-based diagnosis/stratification
special_settings.Theranostic Trials: Trials combining a diagnostic/targeting strategy with a linked therapeutic intervention
